title: Noetherian cohomology vanishing by irreducible component induction
statement: Assume that for every irreducible Noetherian topological space Y, every nonnegative integer e with dim Y <= e [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], every abelian sheaf G on Y, and every integer r>e, H^r(Y,G) [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology] is zero. Let X be a Noetherian topological space, let d be a nonnegative integer with dim X <= d, and let F be an abelian sheaf on X. Then H^q(X,F) is zero for every integer q>d, including when X is empty.

source.place: Proposition 02UZ proof, induction on irreducible components

proof.text: Use NoetherianSpace.exists_finset_irreducible on the whole closed space to obtain a finite irreducible closed cover; each member is Noetherian and irreducible and has dimension at most the ambient bound by topologicalKrullDim_subspace_le.
The private fixed-bound helper applies finite closed-cover vanishing to the irreducible vanishing hypothesis on each member.
At the fixed bound d and degree q, specialize hIrred to each cover member and its inherited dimension inequality, and apply the private helper.

lean.statement:
theorem noetherian_vanishing_of_irreducible_components
    (hIrred : ∀ (Y : Type u) [TopologicalSpace Y] [NoetherianSpace Y]
      [IrreducibleSpace Y] (d : ℕ)
      (hdim : topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
      (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
      (q : ℕ) (hq : d < q),
      IsZero (Sheaf.H' F q (⊤ : Opens Y)))
    (X : Type u) [TopologicalSpace X] [NoetherianSpace X]
    (d : ℕ) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (d : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (F : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (q : ℕ) (hq : d < q) :
    IsZero (Sheaf.H' F q (⊤ : Opens X))
